subject: Model mix & pricing — follow up and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Thompson <alex@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Model mix & pricing — follow up and next steps

Hi Alex — thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap + next steps on the items we discussed so your procurement and engineering teams have something to work from.

Highlights from the call:
- Primary use case: customer support + knowledge base search (chat + rerank) across US and EU customers.
- Expected steady-state traffic: ~200M tokens/month initially, with 6–12 month ramp to 500M/mo (peak planning).
- Model mix you mentioned as likely: chat generation (assistant/chat) heavy, embeddings for search/semantic similarity, and small volume of rerank calls for high-quality results.
- Target procurement budget: looking for unit economics in the neighborhood of $800–$1,200 per 1M tokens (goal to fit Q4 budget).

Ask / next steps from Redwood:
1) Confirm approximate split across models (chat / embeddings / rerank) — we sketched 70/25/5 during the call; please confirm if that's accurate.
2) Procurement: do you have a target committed spend or contract term preference (12/24 months)?
3) Any security/compliance artifacts we should surface early (SOC 2, data residency)?

Attached is a quick cost workbook (Redwood_pricing_model_mix_v2.xlsx) that maps model mixes to example monthly costs at different $/1M token targets. I included three scenarios (conservative, expected, aggressive).

I'll also loop in Rishi and Monica to help finalize pricing options and to prepare an initial draft MAPA/term sheet once you confirm mix and budget range.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_pricing_model_mix_v2.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)

From: Alex Thompson <alex@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@brightlayer.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing — follow up and next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our end:

1) Model mix: after a quick sync with our ML lead, the expected split is close to what we discussed but slightly more embeddings-heavy for the search layer. Proposed split: chat 65%, embeddings 30%, rerank 5%. We'll likely separate embeddings usage between periodic bulk indexing (batches) and per-query lookups — the workbook notes on tokenization will help.

2) Volumes: the 200M tokens/month is our conservative estimate for initial launch (Phase 1). We are budgeting for a Q3–Q4 ramp; plan B assumes 400–500M tokens/mo by end of 2026.

3) Budget target: procurement wants final pricing to be in the $700–$1,000 per 1M tokens range for our blended usage (we realize per-model pricing will vary). If Redwood can provide a blended rate near $800/1M for committed volumes (12–24mo term), that puts us in a good spot.

4) Compliance: SOC 2 Type II and a short data residency note should be enough for the product team at this stage; procurement may ask for more later.

Happy to hop on a short call with Rishi to review the workbook and walk through the blended examples.

—Alex
Alex Thompson
Head of Product
BrightLayer

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Thompson <alex@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing — follow up and next steps

Alex — thank you, that's really helpful and aligned. I've attached a short PDF that shows two example blended-cost scenarios based on the splits you gave (65/30/5) and two blended unit-price targets ($800 and $1,000 per 1M tokens). Summary below so procurement has quick numbers to work with: 

Assumptions (Phase 1): total = 200,000,000 tokens/month
- chat (65%): 130,000,000 tokens
- embeddings (30%): 60,000,000 tokens
- rerank (5%): 10,000,000 tokens

Example blended cost math (simple):
Scenario A (blended target = $800 / 1M tokens):
- Total 1M-token units = 200 (since 200M tokens)
- Blended monthly cost = 200 * $800 = $160,000 / month

Scenario B (blended target = $1,000 / 1M tokens):
- Blended monthly cost = 200 * $1,000 = $200,000 / month

Per-model note (illustrative unit rates we might propose in a commitment):
- chat (larger, generative): $1,000 / 1M tokens
- embeddings (batched / lookup optimized): $400 / 1M tokens
- rerank (small but compute-heavy per call): $2,500 / 1M tokens

Using those per-model rates with the 130M/60M/10M token split gives: 
- chat cost = 130 * $1,000 / 1M = $130,000
- embeddings cost = 60 * $400 / 1M = $24,000
- rerank cost = 10 * $2,500 / 1M = $25,000
- Total = $179,000 / month (blended ≈ $895 / 1M) — falls within your $700–$1,000 band.

If you'd like a committed blended rate of $800 / 1M on a 12–24mo term, we can model an ARR commitment and draft a term sheet. Rishi can run the elasticity of price vs. committed volume and provide concrete breakpoints (e.g., 250M/mo, 400M/mo) where blended drops further.

Next steps from our side:
- Rishi: create a 3-tier commitment proposal and send a short MAPA (mutual action plan) with milestone dates.
- Marissa (me): draft a concise procurement-friendly pricing summary (blended rates + per-model illustrative rates) for your procurement team.
- Alex / Procurement: confirm preferred term length (12 vs 24 months) and whether BrightLayer will do a committed monthly token target or annual spend commitment.

Attaching: model-split-cost-example.pdf (one-page summary). Happy to jump on a 20-min call to walk through details.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: model-split-cost-example.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Model mix & pricing — follow up and next steps

Quick internal note — Alex confirmed 65/30/5 split and a target blended budget in the $700–$1,000 / 1M tokens range. Phase 1 = 200M tokens/mo. Procurement is positive about a 12–24mo committed rate if we can get to ~$800 blended.

Rishi: please build three commitment tiers (250M, 400M, 600M equivalent monthly) with blended rates and margin impact. Focus on options that let us show savings at 12mo and further discount at 24mo. Also include operational notes: whether embeddings can be batched/archived to reduce live token counts and typical latency trade-offs.

Monica: please pull SOC 2 Type II summary + the minimal data residency note for BrightLayer (they operate in US + EU). We'll send these to procurement once Rishi's deck is ready.

I'll wait for your internal draft before sending a formal MAPA to Alex.

Thanks — Marissa
